title: Add contrast target-size and reflow checks
description: Verify and fix representative WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, non-text contrast, target-size, zoom, and reflow issues in the final UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Text and non-text contrast pass AA on representative light/dark themes and both locales
Interactive targets meet the applicable minimum target-size/spacing requirements or have documented exceptions
Content remains usable at 200% zoom/reflow without two-dimensional scrolling or obscured focus
Checks produce before/after evidence for representative routes and themes

steps.description: Run a browser/automated check on representative routes for contrast, target sizes, reflow, and focus visibility; record failures before edits.
Read globals/theme styles, Tailwind tokens, buttons, badges, tables, and layout components; identify the smallest shared fixes.
Adjust tokens/components/layout only where evidence fails, preserving existing branding and both locales.
Repeat checks at desktop/mobile/zoom, light/dark, en/fa; run typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: Do not claim full WCAG conformance from a few representative routes; record route scope and limitations.
actualOutcome: 72/72 contrast, non-text, target-size and reflow assertions pass across 8 routes x 2 locales x 2 themes in real Chromium; 8/8 mutants killed. Seven real defects fixed, the largest being a bare `* { border-color }` rule that silently defeated every border-<color> utility in the app (Tailwind v4 does not layer utilities above unlayered CSS). Not WCAG 2.2 AA certification: see limitations in the evidence file.
